artworks.title: Veue des petittes Cascades de Vaux
artworks.artist: Israël Silvestre
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a formal garden with small cascades. In the background, there is a grand building with classical architecture partially hidden by trees. The ground level features pathways, gardens, and people in period clothing. Trees frame the scene on both sides, with a dense cluster of foliage on the right. The style is etching-like, with fine lines detailing both the architecture and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow. Two figures near the viewer seem engaged in conversation.

artworks.title: Sarah Bernhardt as Melisande
artworks.artist: Paul Berthon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur and Charlotte Vershbow
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the shoulders up. She has delicate facial features, light eyes, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips. Her hair is auburn and voluminous, framing her face. She wears a garment with a patterned neckline against a textured brown background. Large pink flowers with intricate petals and green leaves surround her. The background is warm and golden-brown with floral and leafy motifs.

artworks.title: Pastoral Scene
artworks.artist: Anton Maria Zanetti I, after Jacopo Zanguidi, called Bertoia
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in black and green, with green watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Washington Print Club in memory of Daryl R. Rubenstein
artworks.description: This is a painting of a pastoral scene with figures engaged in various activities. The image illustrates a rural setting where several nude figures are involved in milking animals. A central figure leans over a large tub, while another pours liquid into a container. In the background, a building with a smoking chimney and arched entryway is visible. To the left, a sculpture-like figure stands in a contrapposto pose. The scene features a variety of textures, with hatch lines and shading adding depth and form to the figures and landscape. This painting reflects bucolic themes typically found in works exploring human interaction with nature.

artworks.title: Imaginary Portrait of an English Gentleman
artworks.artist: Thomas Frye
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile view, leaning forward with their hand supporting their face. They have well-groomed hair and are dressed elegantly in a coat with a white shirt or cravat visible. The person appears contemplative, gazing into the distance.

artworks.title: Imaginary Portrait of an English Beauty
artworks.artist: Thomas Frye
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up portrait of a woman from the shoulders up. She is shown in profile, turning slightly towards the viewer with her gaze directed forward. The woman has delicate facial features, a smooth complexion, arched eyebrows, and full lips. She has light-colored hair styled neatly under an ornate cap with a bow. She wears a luxurious garment with fur trim and intricate lace underneath. A choker around her neck is made of gathered fabric and tied with a bow. She wears an earring consisting of a short string of pearls with a large drop pearl. Her hand is resting gently on her collar, partially covering her chest. The background is a plain, darkened space.

artworks.title: Peccati Mortisque Triumphor Christus
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up. He is positioned with his head tilted slightly upward, looking towards the sky or ceiling, with his facial features prominently displayed. He has an elongated face with a pronounced nose, a full beard, and long hair that touches his shoulders. His expression is serene and contemplative. The man is dressed in a robe with a visible loose, ruffled collar and holds a long, staff-like object in his left hand. Surrounding the upper portion of the image is a textured background that creates an air of depth. Below the man, there is a Latin inscription, framed within a decorative border. The print is rendered in black and white.

artworks.title: Trinitatis delicia Virgo Maria
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body. She is in a three-quarter view, with her head tilted slightly downward and her eyes closed. Her facial features are soft, with a gently rounded face, and her hair is mostly covered by a garment, though a portion is visible at the front. She is wearing a headscarf that drapes around her shoulders and a blouse with a slight ruffle at the neckline. Her hands are clasped over her chest. The background is a plain, textured surface without any distinct objects or features.

artworks.title: Sanctus Andreas
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body, focusing primarily on his head, shoulders, and right arm. The man is positioned slightly turned to his left and gazes upward with an intense expression. He has a white beard covering his chin and jawline, and white hair slightly receding from his forehead. His facial features show age and experience with accentuated lines and shading. He wears a robe or cloak with a white collar. His right hand is raised, holding a wooden beam or stick, showing prominent knuckles. The background is textured and shaded, emphasizing the man's expression and features.

artworks.title: Sanctus Bartholomeaus
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man in profile. He is facing the left side but looking up. The man has a beard and mustache, with short receding hair. He is draped in a cloth over one shoulder, holding a large knife against his chest with his right hand. The background is plain and dark. The frame includes handwritten text reading "Sanctus Bartholomeus."

artworks.title: Sanctus Jacobus Major
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image features a man sitting with his upper body turned to the left, looking sideways. He has a full beard, long hair, and is holding a walking staff. He wears a dark garment draped over his shoulders. The background is a textured surface, with an inscription at the bottom reading "Sanctus Jacobus Major."

artworks.title: Sanctus Lucas
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person's upper half, focusing on the profile of their head and shoulders. The person is seated and leans slightly forward in three-quarter profile facing left. They have defined facial features with a prominent nose and a draped cloth covering their head. They wear a collared garment and hold a thin object in their hand, poised above another object. The background is dark, highlighting the figure. The engraving is framed with the text "Sanctus Lucas" below.

artworks.title: Saint Mark
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated in a writing position. He has a prominent nose, thick eyebrows, a full beard, wavy receding hair, and is wearing a simple robe or tunic. He is focused on writing in a book on the table. The background features a plain, closely hatched pattern. The engraving includes a partial border and the text "Sanctus Marcus."

artworks.title: Sanctus Matteaus
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image shows an older man in a side profile, focusing on his upper body and head. He is seated with his head turned slightly downward, engaging with an open book held close to his face. The man has distinctive facial features, including a prominent bald head and a full, bushy beard. He is wearing a garment draped over his shoulders, though specific details of the clothing are obscured by the monochrome shading. There is no visible jewelry. The background is a simple, textured surface without any distinct patterns or objects, and the image is framed by a drawn border with a caption below that reads "Sanctus Matthaeus."

artworks.title: Sanctus Paulus
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter bust of an older man facing slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features, a large nose, deep-set eyes, and a long beard. His hair is long and wavy, framing his face. He wears a draped robe or cloak and holds a long object that resembles a book or parchment. The background has a cross-hatching pattern, and there are inscriptions, including "Sanctus Paulus" and the artist's information, at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Sanctus Phillipus
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image displays a man in a portrait from the waist up, slightly leaning forward with his head turned to the side. His facial features include a prominent nose and well-defined brows. His eyes are downward cast, and his expression appears neutral. He has long, gray, wavy hair, and wears a loose-fitting robe. The man is holding a wooden cross. The background is a textured dark surface. At the bottom of the image, there is text including the name "Sanctus Philippus." The portrait is bordered by a rectangular design.

artworks.title: Sanctus Simeon
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a three-quarter profile from the shoulders up. He has a full beard and short hair, wearing a draped garment. His head is slightly bowed and turned to the side. His posture suggests he is holding an object with both hands. The background has a textured pattern and the image is bordered with a decorative frame line. The inscription below the image reads "Sanctus Simeon." Below the title, it attributes the artwork to Jo. Batta Piazzetta and mentions that it is part of a print series.

artworks.title: Alexander, Lord Loughborough
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi after James Northcote
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting in a formal, upright position. The individual has distinct white curls of hair and a solemn expression. They wear an ornate robe and hold a decorative fabric or sash. The background includes heavy drapery and part of an architectural element, possibly a column.

artworks.title: Edward, Lord Thurlow
artworks.artist: Francesco Bartolozzi after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of Edward Lord Thurlow, Lord High Chancellor of Great Britain. He is seated, holding a round tasseled object, with one hand resting on an armrest. He is depicted with a distinguished expression, defined facial features, and thick, white, curly hair. He wears an ornate robe with lace and intricate patterns, a dark vestment, and a white ruffled shirt collar. In the background, there is a decorative chair with floral motifs on the upholstery, and a crown is placed next to him.

artworks.title: Ein Monitari Indianer
artworks.artist: Karl Bodmer
artworks.description: The image shows the full body of a person standing upright. They are positioned facing forward with their head slightly turned to the left. The person has long, straight hair and distinct facial features that include a strong jawline and a prominent nose. They are dressed in traditional attire, which includes a large, decorated cloak or shawl adorned with intricate patterns, and leggings that reach the center of their thighs. The individual is holding a long staff or spear with a tuft of hair at its end. Around their neck hangs a series of large, circular necklaces. Attached to their hair is a feather. The background consists of an outdoor landscape with hills or mountains in the distance and some plants and grass near the person's feet. In the far distance, two smaller figures are visible standing among some trees.

artworks.title: L'Inquietude
artworks.artist: Achille Devéria
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting by a window. She is seated on a chair next to the window, with one arm on the windowsill and the other in her lap. She has an elaborate updo, wearing a long dress with a high collar, a ribbon at the waist, and sleeves covering her arms. A small decorative tabletop is next to her, holding a container. Another chair in front of her has a basket with fabric or clothing items. The background shows a dimly lit room with heavy drapes, a framed portrait on the wall, and a lattice design on the window. Light is filtering in from outside.

artworks.title: Figures in a Landscape
artworks.artist: William Hart
artworks.medium: graphite with white gouache on brown paper
artworks.description: The image is a landscape view from an elevated perspective, showing a serene countryside scene with distant hills or mountains on the horizon. The ground features rocky terrain, vegetation, and a small body of water. Two human figures are partially obscured in the distance. The painting's brushstrokes are subtle and textured, with a color palette dominated by brown tones and white highlights.

artworks.title: Norman Structure
artworks.artist: Childe Hassam
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on (bristol board?)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a multi-story building with a tower rising above the structure. The horizon is not shown. The tower has a pole at its peak. The architectural features are detailed with fine linework, emphasizing texture and structure. The windows, doors, and chimneys provide depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using black ink on beige paper. A wooden fence runs along the base of the building.

artworks.title: Prometheus Bound
artworks.artist: Christian Schussele
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a man chained to two large rocks, with one arm chained above his head and the other chained at his side. He has long, curly hair and is nude except for a cloth draped across his waist. A large black bird is perched on his chest, appearing to peck at him. The background shows a rocky landscape with waves crashing against the rocks under a gray sky.

artworks.title: Charity
artworks.artist: Benjamin West
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on gray paper mounted to brown laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows multiple figures' upper bodies, centered around a standing person and two cherubic children. The central figure is an adult standing and presented in profile, gazing downward, with a serene expression. This figure has curly hair falling to the shoulders, classical features, a prominent nose, and a gentle smile. The clothing suggests classical drapery covering the torso loosely. Next to the central figure are two cherubic figures, mostly nude, with playful, rounded features and small wings. One cherub leans against the standing figure, while another lies across the lap of a seated figure. The background consists of simple, curved lines creating an arched frame, matching the page's shape, with no distinct setting depicted.
